messages:
talia_support: Customer reports promo code WELCOME2026 shows "invalid or expired" at checkout. User email: jordan+work@gmail.com. Signed up via GitHub SSO. Request-id: req_0a7f3c. Can we triage?

ashish_eng: Can you paste the API response / request-id? usually promo_ineligible has a reason field.

talia_support: API response: ```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "promo_ineligible",
  "reason": "trial_already_used",
  "promo": "WELCOME2026",
  "request_id": "req_0a7f3c"
}
```
Also pulled account flags: ```
account_id: acct_72b9
email: jordan+work@gmail.com
canonical_email: jordan@gmail.com
identity_providers: ["github"]
has_used_trial: true
created_at: 2024-11-02T14:22:10Z
```
User insists they never redeemed a trial. They say they created a throwaway account months ago and can't remember details.

omar_ops: This looks like identity fusion. Our account linker maps canonical_email (jordan@gmail.com) across SSO and plain signup and carried a consumed_trial flag from the old throwaway. Check admin audit for merged accounts: `/admin/accounts/acct_72b9/audit` — look for `merge_source` entries.

ashish_eng: Confirmed in audit: acct_72b9 merged with acct_8f1c on 2024-11-02; acct_8f1c had has_used_trial:true. So the promo eligibility check blocks new redemption because has_used_trial persisted after account merge.

patrick_billing: If we need to get the customer unblocked immediately we can issue a manual credit for the promo amount (trial credit = $50). I need approval from eng to either flip the flag or run targeted grant.

ashish_eng: Two options: 1) clear `has_used_trial` on acct_72b9 in the DB (fast, but touches billing flags) OR 2) run our admin grant endpoint to apply the promo for this account: `POST /admin/promos/grant` with {account_id, promo_code, reason}. The grant endpoint records audit and is reversible. I recommend #2.

omar_ops: +1 to using grant endpoint. It keeps the history intact. Also we'll add a short-term rule to ignore merged-account trial flags for promo checks for forward-looking trials (ENG hotfix if needed).

patrick_billing: I can do the grant once eng confirms request payload. Talia, please confirm you have user's explicit consent to apply credit.

dev-bot: build #2024.11 deployed — no infra changes required for admin grant.

talia_support: User confirmed. Please proceed.

ashish_eng: Payload ready: ```
POST /admin/promos/grant 
Body: {
  "account_id": "acct_72b9",
  "promo_code": "WELCOME2026",
  "reason": "Support override for identity-fusion merged account (req_0a7f3c)",
  "operator": "patrick_billing"
}
```
I approve. Omar, can you review DB constraints quickly?

omar_ops: Reviewed — grant endpoint will bypass `has_used_trial` check for operator-invoked requests and will emit audit event. Safe to proceed.

patrick_billing: Grant executed at 2026-03-17T16:28:45Z. Transaction id tx_559c. Customer notified and credit applied.

patrick_billing: Follow-up: I issued $50 credit, left note in billing: "support override for promo WELCOME2026, acct_72b9, req_0a7f3c, tx_559c"

ashish_eng: Filed ENG-3219 to adjust merge behavior: do not carry forward `has_used_trial` into merged accounts without explicit provenance. Tagging Omar + Talia.

talia_support: Customer confirmed redemption works now and says thanks. Closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
